statistics: Source-clock means, 20 measured per size and model.
overflow: Full migration exceeds 1s; double wavy bar end marks omitted height. Labels retain actual total (total minus page scan).
small_bars: Actual heights, without a minimum display height; labels in ms with leaders.
limits: Nested KVM and emulated shared CXL on one physical host; not a physical multi-host CXL result.
First page scan includes EPT faults, guest execution, backing faults, cold caches and observation delays; it is not isolated EPT construction.
Guest scan checks 64 bytes per 4KiB page, not every byte of W.
Only source-local elapsed observations form the additive total; destination stage durations and profiles are diagnostic and must not be added across nodes.
Preparation is outside pause-to-ACK and reported separately, rather than treated as free.
The full-RAM TCP baseline used a different CPU profile and RAM backend. Its comparison is descriptive, not an isolated causal backend test.
Raw rounds 0..3 are retained separately; initial EPT validation/metadata binding differs from repeated handoffs.

Semantic B boots a disposable same-configuration guest on the same backing before A boots; direct B has no such guest seed. Initial visit scans therefore have different backing/translation warmness and are not a one-factor cold comparison.
